items.title: Legal Name Verification
items.guidance: Check the company legal name matches name in official regigration documents and cross check with national or international company regisration database

items.title: Company Registration Number Check
items.guidance: Validate the company’s registration number with the appropriate government authority or regulatory body

items.title: Registered Address Verification
items.guidance: Cross-check the company's registered address with official documents (e.g., incorporation certificate). Confirm through a third-party address verification tool or service

items.title: Industry Classification
items.guidance: Verify the company’s business activities match their registered industry code (e.g., NAICS, SIC)

items.title: Parent/Subsidiaries Information
items.guidance: Confirm the ownership structure and any subsidiaries to understand the overall corporate structure

items.title: Owner and Key Executive Identification
items.guidance: Obtain and validate the details of beneficial owners, directors, and key executives. Verify the identification and ownership percentages

items.title: Ownership Verification
items.guidance: Ensure that ownership information is up-to-date and matches shareholder records (e.g., annual returns, shareholder registry).

items.title: Directors and Shareholders Scrutiny
items.guidance: Cross-check with government or regulatory databases to verify ownership and historical involvement with other businesses

sections.title: Sanctions & Watch List Screening
sections.guidance: Complete the following checks for sanctions and watchlist

items.title: Sanctions Lists Screening
items.guidance: Use an updated tool or service to check against global sanctions lists (e.g., OFAC, UN, EU). Verify the company, its owners, and key executives are not listed on any sanctions or restricted entities list.

items.title: Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) Check
items.guidance: Verify whether any beneficial owners, directors, or executives are politically exposed persons. Use dedicated services for PEP screening (e.g., World-Check, LexisNexis).

items.title: Adverse Media Screening
items.guidance: Conduct media searches to identify negative press or allegations of fraudulent activity, money laundering, etc

items.title: Wallet Uniqueness Check
items.guidance: Checks that the Wallet Address associated with this Registration has not been registered previously

sections.title: Know your business
sections.guidance: Complete the following checklist to ensure we can deal with the business

items.title: Company Registration Documents
items.guidance: Verify company registration documents, including certificates of incorporation and business licenses

items.title: Director and UBO Checks
items.guidance: Verify identities of directors and ultimate beneficial owners, including ownership structure

items.title: KYC Checks
items.guidance: Complete standard Know Your Customer checks including identity verification

items.title: Sanctions and Watchlists
items.guidance: Screen company and key individuals against sanctions lists and watchlists

items.title: Credit Bureau Reports
items.guidance: Review credit reports and financial history from credit bureaus

sections.title: Counter Party Checks
sections.guidance: Complete the following checklist to ensure the counter party is reliable

items.title: Buyer Verification
items.guidance: Verify buyer's identity, business operations, and legitimacy

items.title: Payment Behaviour
items.guidance: Review buyer's payment history and behavior with other suppliers

items.title: Contracts
items.guidance: Review contracts between seller and buyer for terms and conditions

sections.title: Invoice Validation
sections.guidance: Check each of the invoices included in the deal to esnure their authenticity

items.title: Invoice Authenticity
items.guidance: Verify authenticity of invoices through supporting documentation

items.title: Delivery Evidence
items.guidance: Check proof of delivery or service completion

items.title: Assignment Deeds
items.guidance: Review invoice assignment documentation and legal requirements

items.title: Debtor Acknowledgement
items.guidance: Obtain acknowledgement from debtor regarding invoice validity

sections.title: Fraud Checks
sections.guidance: Review invoices and related documents for evidence of fraud.

items.title: Fraud Checks
items.guidance: Perform fraud detection checks on invoices and related documents
